game_concept: A racing platformer set in Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar, an altar half-sunk in earth: the scholar mage must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Search Scout: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar: an altar half-sunk in earth
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declare int: declare resource as int, apply resource, and print each result with %d. Dataset 2 starts with [-3, 0, 5, 8]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Search Scout' (Week 7 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Sunken Altar'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the moon altar by solving code steps involving found that move the scholar mage forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the moon altar first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Declare before use. int resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %d.
